messages:
jason_cust: Hey team, customer hitting weird rerank results after we combined embeddings from two services. Scores are all clustered near 0.0/negative and ranking is nonsense. No explicit API error, just bad outputs.

sam_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact payload you sent to /v1/rerank and the embedding metadata?

jason_cust: Yep pasted below. Note: embeddings were produced by an older internal model (embed-lite-v1) and the rerank call used model=rerank-v2. Payload:```{
  "query_embedding": {"model": "embed-lite-v1", "dims": 512, "vector": [ /* trimmed */ ]},
  "candidate_embeddings": [{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","dims":1536,"vector": [/* trimmed */]}]
}```

kevin_ml: Ah, looks like mixed dims. rerank-v2 expects candidates + query to be same dimensionality for cosine/inner product. If you pass mismatched vectors it won't error — the scorer treats them as different-length slices which yields garbage.

sam_support: Is there any server-side validation that can catch this? The customer didn't get an error, just bad quality.

olivia_research: We used to validate dims for rerank in older infra, but recent rollout that allows external hosting removed strict checks to be more permissive. We should re-enable a fast pre-check and surface a 4xx if dims mismatch.

jason_cust: For now the customer needs a repro case and a mitigation. They have noisy production traffic, can't just rollback. Any quick fixes?

kevin_ml: Quick mitigations: 1) Detect model names and block pairings (recommended) 2) Auto-resize by zero-padding/truncating vectors (fast but biologically wrong) 3) Convert to a shared embedding via internal re-embed or run a compatibility transform (affine) if we have mapping.

sam_support: Can you share how the scoring looked? Any logs?

jason_cust: Log snippet (score field from rerank response):```[ -0.12, -0.08, 0.01, -0.20, 0.03 ]``` Ranking is reversed compared to expected. Customer ran a basic sanity check comparing cosines computed locally and they diverged.

kevin_ml: If query is 512 and candidate is 1536, and you compute dot on first 512 dims vs full 1536 dims, results will be meaningless. Also our normalization assumes equal dims when doing cosine.

olivia_research: Repro steps we used: 1) Take a sample query q_512 and candidate c_1536. 2) Pad q_512 with zeros to 1536 and compute cosine -> gives one result. 3) Truncate c_1536 to 512 and compute cosine -> different result. 4) Use mismatched shapes in our rerank API -> closely matches truncated behavior, explains weirdness.

sam_support: Thanks. Jason — can you ask the customer to share a minimal reproducible request (we only need one query + 3 candidates) and example model names? We'll escalate and propose a hotfix.

jason_cust: Sent repro in DM. Also customer wants to know if this could be a billing issue (different charged units per model) — they're seeing spikes.

sam_support: Billing: different embedding models have different per-unit pricing. Mixing models could cause unexpected cost, but not billing breaks. I'll loop in billing if you want. @infra-bot can you create an incident/triage item for rerank-dim-validation?

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1283 — "rerank: dimension compatibility validation missing". Priority: P2. Assignee: kevin_ml.

kevin_ml: I'll take it. Short term patch: add preflight dims check in the HTTP layer and return 400 with message: "embedding dimension mismatch between query and candidate; ensure same model/dimension." Longer term: add model pairing whitelist and telemetry to detect mixed pipelines.

olivia_research: Also propose we emit a quality-alert when rerank score distribution is abnormal (e.g., stdev < 0.02 or mean near zero) — that will catch silent failures.

sam_support: Good. Jason — please relay both patches to the customer: 1) immediate validation will cause a 400 (safe), 2) we can offer a temporary server-side pad/convert if they prefer graceful degradation. Which would they prefer?

jason_cust: Customer prefers hard fail for now to avoid silent bad UX. They will pause the mixed workflow until validation is live.

sam_support: Great. I'll update the ticket and post ETA once kevin has a patch. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
